dialogues.speaker: Zavyalov
dialogues.text: Hm? Ah, I mean, the Shadow Realm really is every bit as dangerous as the former Chairperson said it was.

dialogues.speaker: Zavyalov
dialogues.text: As everyone knows, Kresnik's Torches are scattered all across Snezhnaya. Since the Energy Commission is responsible for maintaining them, our people are constantly traveling from place to place. So every now and then, someone ends up crossing paths with a Shadow Realm.

dialogues.speaker: Zavyalov
dialogues.text: When that happens, the priority is to get out safely and report it to the Druzhna.
